THRUST_RESPONSE.meaning: the load-cell thrust per unit commanded thrust of motor m, against its own pre-event window, fell beyond the nominal-corpus threshold (VIOLATED) or did not (NOMINAL); UNAVAILABLE if the load cell's samples do not cover the window

configuration_assumptions: motor m on a single-axis load cell, rigidly mounted, no contact with the guard
the load cell's timebase aligned to the FC by the logic analyzer's sync pulse
expected_inputs: a PX4 ULog of the run (actuator_motors, esc_status)
a load-cell CSV: time (s, on the FC timebase, rounded to whole microseconds: see D-PRIME-1), thrust (N)
fault_behavior: a statistic that cannot be computed is UNAVAILABLE (INPUTS_MISSING), never NOMINAL
thresholds: from the nominal corpus only: 2 x the largest null value; 99.9th percentile reported (B4_MATCHED_AB_PROTOCOL.md section 6)
validity_rule: the AFTER window, as the stock compensation
